entries.title: gm/ID Explorer - Open PDK Hub
entries.desc: Unified gm/ID explorer for three open-source PDKs: interactive MOSFET characterisation curves (gm/ID, fT, gm/gds and more versus V<sub>GS</sub>, V<sub>ov</sub> and channel length) for gm/ID-based analog design.

entries.title: Career Semi-Quant Terminal
entries.desc: Quantitative stock analytics for semiconductor professionals evaluating equity offers. Runs entirely in the browser.

entries.title: FX Quant Terminal
entries.meta: Seven INR pairs · ECB reference rates
entries.desc: Quantitative analysis of seven INR currency pairs (EUR, USD, GBP, JPY, CNY, SGD, HKD) for timing a transfer: ensemble forecasts (ARIMA, Holt-Winters, Monte Carlo), technical indicators, risk and seasonality, on ECB rates refreshed daily by a data bot.

entries.title: Research Radar
entries.desc: Live feed of the newest papers and posts in AI, finance and chip design: arXiv, Hugging Face trending papers, the latest IEEE JSSC, TCAS, TVLSI, TCAD and IEEE Micro articles, Semantic Scholar and research blogs, refreshed every 3 hours, with an optional Claude-powered paper explainer.

entries.title: Conference Deadline Tracker
entries.desc: Tracks conference information such as submission deadlines, with a calendar feed and change log.

entries.title: Secure DSM + PUF - Signal Path Explorer
entries.desc: Interactive signal-path explorer for a secure delta-sigma sensor front end, running a behavioural model live in the browser. Compares the ESSERC'25 S-DSM baseline with a proposed SRAM-PUF + fuzzy extractor + NLFSR scheme, and lets you probe every block, from the modulator bitstream to key recovery, under attack scenarios.
